note: V-World 2D data catalog snapshot, 158 items transcribed from the official 16-page list. The source block is a verbatim transcription and is checked character by character against capture.raw_file; the local block holds our fields. typename values are copied from a measured WFS GetCapabilities listing, never assembled from the service id: four boundary items advertise an alias layer name (the _INFO spelling returns an OWS ExceptionReport) and four items have no WFS layer under any spelling, so they ship with supported=false and a reason. The generator writes verified=false for every row, because a transcription is not a working call, and only a person raises that flag after a real collection has returned features: as of 2026-10-17 that is vworld.lt_c_ademd_info alone, raised by hand. Generated by scripts/54_build_vworld_catalog.py, which does not carry the local block over - regenerating this file resets verified and notes to the generator defaults, so diff those two fields after a regeneration. Hand edits are limited to local.verified and local.notes; the source block and typename values come from the generator only.
